title: AIUseCase
description: A registered AI use case (ZTAX-AIGOV-001 §3; ADR-0006 §2.5). Registration is the whole control: the Gateway refuses an unregistered use case, so a new AI capability cannot ship by deploying code that calls the Gateway, only by a reviewed registry change on the AI train with a named owner.
$comment: Required fields are exactly ztax_gateway.governance.UseCase, which the Python schema test serializes and validates. The optional fields are the remainder of the AIGOV-001 §3 inventory. permitted_data_classes is enforced by the Go policy gate (ai.UseCasePolicy) and, when absent, means no data class is permitted.

max_risk_tier.description: The highest tier this use case may operate at. A request above it is refused, never downgraded.

max_authority.description: The highest authority outcome this use case may produce. Never A5.

suspended.description: Takes the use case out of service without removing its registration, so the history of what it was remains readable. The per-use-case kill switch.

permitted_data_classes.description: The PRIV-001 classes this use case may send to a model. Deny by default: a class not listed is refused.
